timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Three aspects make figure 01 stands out among other humanoid robots due to its unique combination of advanced AI and physical capabilities.
Figure 01 employs cutting edge AI for language comprehension and physical execution, as well as it, features visual motor transformers,
translating images into actions, and operates with 24 degrees of freedom at 200 hertz for fluid movements.
Figure 01 designed as the world's first commercially viable autonomous humanoid robot and aims to address labor shortages and unsafe job conditions.
3. Human form factor Figure 01 mimics human dexterity for efficiency in various tasks and capable of navigating environments designed for humans.

This is why the company behind Figure 01, which is Figure AI Inc., which was founded only in 2022 in California, with a focus on general purpose humanoid robots, managed within just one year of its inception, to raise $70 million fund, and now they raised a $675 million from very serious types of investors like Microsoft, Nvidia, Jeff Bezos, Intel Capital, and many others.
According to their website, Figure Inc's mission is to expand human capabilities through advanced AI.
They aim to do so by specifically targeting the labor force.
Because according to Figure Market Data, the labor force is shrinking.

They mentioned that there are 10 million unfilled jobs in the United States only, where 7 million of those job are for essential roles, such as warehouse, transportation, and retail, and there is no enough human labor for that demand.
Figure 01 will join the workforce with the ability to think, learn, and interact with their environment safely alongside us.

Figure AI declared that their biggest breakthrough has come when had recently a partnership with OpenAI, which dramatically helped enhancing the capabilities of its robots to process and reason from natural language, using OpenAI's research and large multimodal models.

This is why you can have full conversations with Figure 01 in natural language, and it seems that we are not talking about not just using Figure 01 to help humans do their jobs, but it might be soon replacing human labor entirely.
Figure 01 will join the workforce with the ability to think, learn, and interact with their environment safely alongside us.
